Hana: Quick: Gateway SI (Bridgeworks) requested a final end-to-end dry run for onboarding. Goal: marketplace tile ingestion, SI certification badge toggle, and partner-facing rollback comms. Can eng, ops, and marketing join 08:45 PT tomorrow?
Marco: 08:45 PT OK. I9ll bring the SKU list and ingestion verification checks.
Ishan: Ops will pre-provision partner-only badge and script a public flip. Also include a simulated failure path so partner sees rollback.
Claire: Marketing needs final quote + 2 screenshots by 07:30 PT. We'll share copy under NDA. Embargo until 14:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: Flag detected: `bridgeworks_publish` default=false. API: POST /flags/bridgeworks_publish {"value":"true"}.
Marco: Demo env: staging-gateway-bridge. SKUs: BW-GPU-1, BW-ACC-2.
Ishan: Flip script snippet: ```bash
# flip public
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI" https://deploy/flags/bridgeworks_publish -d '{"value":"true"}'
# rollback
curl -X POST https://deploy/flags/bridgeworks_publish -d '{"value":"false"}'
```
Hana: Add CDN purge step and partner comms template to the runbook. Keep comments minimal during rehearsal.
Claire: Will upload deck & one-pager to the invite. Timeline: 08:45 intros, 08:50 demo, 08:57 flip dry-run, 08:59 simulate failure & rollback, 09:10 retrospective.
Marco: I9ll validate logs 15 mins ahead.
Hana: Invite created. Please be punctual.
